title: Cross-pupil leaderboards / streaks / badges
summary: Reads H1's pupil_attempt rows. Per-class: daily-streak (consecutive days with ≥1 correct), badges (first-attempt-100% on a specRef, longest-streak, most-improved-this-week), opt-in leaderboard (off by default per safeguarding research; initials-only when on; opt-out per-pupil).

in: client/src/lib/gamificationEngine.ts (new, ~250 LoC) — pure deterministic rules engine over pupil_attempt rows
client/src/components/PupilStreakBadge.tsx (new, ~80 LoC) — flame icon + day count for the companion app header
client/src/components/ClassLeaderboard.tsx (new, ~150 LoC) — opt-in leaderboard for the teacher dashboard
client/src/lib/badgeDefinitions.ts (new, ~120 LoC) — frozen list of 12 badges (first-book, century-of-pages, etc. — mirrors the reading-challenge badge pattern from PR #121)
Per-school admin toggle for leaderboard on/off + per-pupil opt-out flag
Targeted vitest: streak rules; badge rules; opt-out honoured
out: Cross-school leaderboards (deferred — privacy + safeguarding review needed)

acceptance_criteria: Streak counter increments daily; resets to 0 if a pupil misses a day with ≥1 correct attempt.
Leaderboard is OFF by default. Admin can turn on per-class. Pupils can opt out individually.
When leaderboard is on, displays initials only (e.g. 'A.K.') — never full name.
Badge rules are pure / deterministic — same pupil_attempt history → same badges.
Engine handles edge cases: leap day, school holidays (no break-streak penalty), pupil joining mid-year.
Research-anchored UX safeguards: bottom-3 pupils are NOT shown on the public leaderboard (only the teacher view); pupils only see their own rank + the cohort percentile.

risk_register.mitigation: Off-by-default; opt-in; bottom-3 hidden from public leaderboard; pupils see percentile not rank; admin toggle requires accepting a one-click safeguarding warning.

risk_register.risk: Streaks pressure pupils to attempt sloppy work just to maintain the streak
risk_register.mitigation: Streak only counts attempts on assigned worksheets (not random self-generated practice); a 1-day grace via 'streak freeze' on weekends.
